about: Meshes whose CHIM collision keeps the standing room over their own floors open (mesh_geometry.collision_parts standing_room, DOOR-USE-COLLISION-FILLED-53): a convex piece that fills the room a player stands in over a walkable face of the mesh is split, and a piece that cannot be split becomes the authored plates of its triangles. A measured table, as config/collision-hull-surface.json: only these meshes change (their collision bytes grow), every other mesh keeps its unit key. A mesh joins when the door engine check or a walk-route check fails on it and the rule is measured to clear it. AMIWIND_COLLISION_STANDING_ROOM=all applies the rule to every mesh, for measurement only (the island survey of 27 October 2026 on the v0.0.53 final image: 190 of 1,380 distinct meshes change). Decided for the project, 27 October 2026.

meshes.meshes/x/ex_dae_ruin_entry.max.nif: the Daedric shrine entry (no RootCollisionNode): with exact plate bevels alone (the v0.0.54-dev2 world, 2026-10-28) its compiled hull still filled the standing room over its steps 8 to 16 units out from the door, and 10 shrine entrances had no standing spot (5 of them reachable on v0.0.53); with the rule all 10 reach their doors, measured on the dev2 frames with the CHIM model builder's workers; collision 143.6 to 182.6 KB per variant (DOOR-USE-COLLISION-FILLED-53)
meshes.meshes/x/ex_redoran_tower_01.nif: the Redoran guard tower: a convex piece of its RootCollisionNode closed the top room over the trapdoors (point hull solid from 2 to 52 units over them); 8 entrances (Ald-ruhn Guard Towers 1 and 2 and its hut door, Maar Gan Guard Towers 1 to 3, the Ald Velothi outpost, Indarys Manor) reach their doors with the rule; collision 32.9 to 48.3 KB per variant (measured on the v0.0.53 final image, 27 October 2026)
